caveat: Stack Overflow question order (first question per tag), users who started after both technologies existed; asking ≠ completing
cohortRule: For pair (A,B) count only users whose first-ever question is >= 12 months after both technologies existed (birth = first appearance of any of the skill's tags on the site); same-day ties dropped; users with 2-40 mapped skills only
edgeFields: from, to, support, reverse, confidence, n, unfiltered{support,reverse,ties}, sample; the tags behind each endpoint are skills[<id>].tags
licence: Stack Overflow content is CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://stackoverflow.com/help/licensing); aggregate counts only

llmEraTopUp.note: run `mine_so.py render-sede`, execute the query on data.stackexchange.com, save the CSV to pipeline/build/so/sede_llm_pairs.csv, re-run emit

noDataSkills.reason: no Stack Overflow tag denotes presenting analysis (report/dashboard/presentation tags are generic)
no Stack Overflow tag denotes security incident response
no established Stack Overflow tag (eval/metrics tags are generic; ragas/langsmith are single-digit)
no Stack Overflow tag denotes contributing to open source
no Stack Overflow tag (prompt is the command-prompt/dialog tag)
no Stack Overflow tag denotes AI ethics/fairness (privacy/transparency tags are generic)
no Stack Overflow tag denotes technical writing
no Stack Overflow tag (stride is the array-stride tag)

orientation: each pair is stored once, oriented so that support >= reverse; confidence = support / n; n = support + reverse after the cohort filter; `unfiltered` keeps the pre-filter counts

samples.sede-5pct: Stack Exchange Data Explorer, current data, 5 % user sample, pairs with an LLM-era endpoint
